# A Signals-suffixed sse callback marshals its argument as a
# datastar-patch-signals event, alongside the template-rendered
# patch-elements events. The suffix keeps the user's own capitalization:
# muxt never derives an identifier from the remainder.

muxt generate --output-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /board sse(Stream(ctx, execute, countsSignals))" -}}<li>{{ .Result }}</li>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Counts struct {
	Open int `json:"open"`
	Done int `json:"done"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, execute func(string) error, countsSignals func(Counts) error) {
	_ = execute("first")
	_ = countsSignals(Counts{Open: 4, Done: 9})
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestSignalsEvents(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/board", nil))

	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}
	body := rec.Body.String()
	for _, want := range []string{
		"event: datastar-patch-elements\n",
		"data: elements <li>first</li>\n",
		"event: datastar-patch-signals\n",
		"data: signals {\"open\":4,\"done\":9}\n",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the wire line %q", body, want)
		}
	}
	if elements, signals := strings.Index(body, "data: elements"), strings.Index(body, "data: signals"); elements > signals {
		t.Errorf("body = %q: the element patch should precede the signals patch", body)
	}
}
